doc: Gated (B). Two agents outside any run in two worktrees of one repository; B's tree has uncommitted lines at the end of src/a.rs and src/b.rs. A's edits to both files close (each its own conflicting prediction against B), then B's own edit of src/a.rs closes (the same pair seen from B): one clash card, rule conflict, for the pair, naming the first file found, and one huddle about it, open (Balanced allows huddles), between the two sessions. Pattern B: work/files naming the edited files (the step snapshot after the edit) is the gate for each turn's edits, __test_barrier settles the hub's prediction jobs before the count is read.

args: mkdir -p $ROOT/work/src && cd $ROOT/work && git init -q -b main && echo one > src/a.rs && echo one > src/b.rs && git add src && git -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@t commit -q -m init && git worktree add -q -b b $ROOT/wt-b && echo from-b >> $ROOT/wt-b/src/a.rs && echo from-b >> $ROOT/wt-b/src/b.rs

params.text:
tool:edit src/a.rs
tool:edit src/b.rs
say done

sql: select count(*) from card where kind = 'clash' and json_extract(data, '$.rule') = 'conflict'
select json_extract(data, '$.files[0]') from card where kind = 'clash'

select count(*) from entity where kind = 'huddle' and retired_tx is null and json_extract(data, '$.state') = 'open' and json_extract(data, '$.rule') = 'conflict' and data like '%$a%' and data like '%$b%'
select count(*) from entity where kind = 'huddle' and retired_tx is null
